atoms.text: Phở is a popular and delicious Vietnamese noodle soup. Phở is made with flat rice noodles, fresh herbs and a type of protein. The protein in phở is usually beef, chicken or tofu.
atoms.sound: Pha is a popular and delicious vietnamese noodle soup. Pha is made with flat rice noodles, fresh herbs and a type of protein. The protein in Pha is usually beef, chicken or tofu.

atoms.text: Some people think that phở is a mix of Chinese, French and Vietnamese food. The rice noodles used in phở are thought to be from southern China, and beef became a popular ingredient when the French colonised Vietnam in the late 19th century.
atoms.sound: Some people think that Pha is a mix of chinese, french and vietnamese food. The rice noodles used in Pha are thought to be from southern China, and beef became a popular ingredient when the french colonised vietnam in the late 19th century.

atoms.text: Phở originally comes from northern Vietnam, near the city of Hanoi. Eventually, phở spread to southern Vietnam. After the Vietnam War, many people moved away from Vietnam, and phở is now a very popular dish all around the world. Although many people eat phở for lunch or dinner, phở is actually a breakfast food. In Vietnam, especially in the summer, it is too hot in the afternoon or evening to eat soup, so the best time to eat phở is in the morning.
